migration.note: Test12 responds to real-device private-KV saturation. Critical persistent state moves from setItem/getItem to rule-private files, while rescue Bootstrap direct-loads the immutable Test12 release instead of Remote Manager state so the old 1MB KV cannot block startup. Strict no-sniff remains HTTP-only and adds player_aaaa/player_data encrypt decoding, parse/jx construction, HTTP status/location/HLS detection and richer static decoding.
